response.original_title: Mary Grace-Movie Edition-・橘メアリー
response.overview: The star of this film is Memetan, also known as Mary Tachibana! With her elegant movements and refined, soothing presence, she is a beautiful woman with a height of 168 cm and a G-cup bust! To capture Mary's best moments on video, as she announced her retirement from adult film acting in May 2026, a filming team was assembled. The perfect setting for her was the tropical island of Amami Oshima. This film was shot in conjunction with the photobook "Grace," which will be released in advance by Futabasha. Mary made her first landing on Amami Oshima, an island that exudes a majestic atmosphere. Everything, from the air to the plants, was a fresh experience for her, and she showed an innocent expression like a young girl. Her dignified presence, which is not overshadowed by the magnificent scale of nature, will be deeply etched in the hearts of viewers. The soft land of Amami watches over actress Mary Tachibana's noble and graceful final stage.
response.title: Mary Grace -Movie Edition- - Mary Tachibana
